name: Machine shortcuts: RETRIG + COLOR, SHAPE, SWEEP or CONTOUR on an added machine's tracks, saved with the sound
description: A part of model27's builder, not a machine (notes/63 §3): assembled once into shortcuts.o by tools/gen_parts.py, added by tools/compose.py to a build in which a machine declares a shortcut. The knob lookup's vtable entry and the three sound record functions jump into it; the composer writes the data block (the machines' shortcuts, the next of the record chain) right after its code, and a package's own wrapper on a record function (SAMPLE's) becomes the next of the chain instead of a hook of its own.

gestures.meaning: the shortcut of the track's machine
